title: oberon-kube
$comment: The schema root is intentionally NOT closed: cozystack-engine injects its own keys (_cluster, _namespace) into the values of every tenant application, and with additionalProperties:false Helm rejects the values entirely, so the application does not deploy.

cluster.description: Name of the cluster, up to 8 characters

key.description: Key of the cluster, up to 16 hex digits; empty means zeros, unauthenticated

deployments.description: Deployments applied at start, e.g. web 4 Ticker; api 2 Ticker2

memory.description: Memory of each machine: an integer number of Mi or Gi, from 128Mi to 1Gi

storageClass.description: Storage class of the machines' volumes
